description: This file defines a PHP script that provides help content for an installation process of SugarCRM / SuiteCRM. It includes class definitions, functions to generate HTML help content for different installation steps, and a web interface to display the help topics dynamically based on user input.

classes.name: HelpItem
classes.description: A class representing a help item with associated field, title, and text.

methods.name: help_menu_html
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the main help menu with links to installation steps.

methods.name: format_help_items
methods.description: Formats a list of HelpItem objects into an HTML table.

methods.name: help_step_1_html
methods.description: Provides HTML content with help information for the first installation step.

methods.name: help_step_2_html
methods.description: Provides HTML content with help information for the second installation step.

methods.name: help_step_3_html
methods.description: Provides HTML content with help information for the third installation step.

methods.name: help_step_4_html
methods.description: Provides HTML help content for the fourth installation step.

methods.name: help_step_5_html
methods.description: Provides HTML help content for the fifth installation step.
